[*] The maps have been improved, and now give some clues on where to go.

[*] Spikes found in caves are nerved and cause less damage.

[*] Waterlilies no longer disappear completely as the player swims closer.

[*] the human closet with 5 drawers can now all be opened.

[*] Click on blackberry message has more space, and is better readable.
 
[*] Talking to NPCs and unlocking new quests now autosaves the game.

[*] Getting a spirit point now makes a sound.

[*] Soldier AI turning their heads too far to the right has been fixed, they no longer have owl necks.

[*] Some code has been simplified and optimized to help prevent lag spikes.

[*] Some animals now spawn in previously animal empty areas. 

[*] Floating mushrooms and bushes near spawn have been removed.

[*] When in the castle you can now see the Steyndike Mazes in the distance.

[*] Ravenwoud has had further optimization.

[*] Hitting a tree with your axe will now spawn some hit particles and move the tree slightly making it seem more like you're hitting it.

[*] Hitting rocks will now spawn rock-hit particles.

[*] Hitting Metal rocks will now also spawn special metal-hit particles.

[*] Gnome king and Soldier have improved beard looks.

[*] You can now use ESC to hide the map, quest scroll, and mobile crafting menu.

[*] Textures have once again had many optimizations.

[*] The game now has improved loading screens.

[*] The appearance of in-game messages has been improved.

[*] The grammar error in gerwini first dialogue has been fixed. Signs, ugh English xD.

[*] Part of the houses built into the Steynstadt university was invisible and has been fixed.

[*] the gates at the end of the mazes were accidentally assigned to the wrong keys.. a foolish mistake, now the southern gate is opened by the southern key and the middle by the middle key, instead of the other way around.

[*] quil no longer disappears when close to it.

[*] you can now rotate placeable objects using the right mouse button (Without first having to press Q).

[*] Save System for player build things has been optimized and reworked, and should now work better.

[*] putting objects into inventory while building and holding an item such as an axe or demolished tool, the item would keep being put into the inventory and be duplicated, this has been fixed.

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.5 New Enemy, Story, and Chickens!
notes.content:
[b]A quick overview of fixed bugs, improvements, and new things added in this update.
[/b]


[b]New In Little Hats:[/b]

[list]
[*] Chickens have been added to the game and can be found often in human towns.

[*] Chicken eggs are added to the game as a food.

[*] Sometimes chickens will lay eggs, and you can steal them, but the chickens will attack.

[*] More caves have been added and some have been connected, you can now also find the golden tuning fork inside the cave with which you can open one of the Steyndike mazes and go to the lowlands! However, in so doing, you might awake a new kind of troll!

[*] A new kind of troll has been added, the dark troll! the dark trolls were imprisoned in the caves long, don't wake them up!

[*] There are now 2 more gnome houses in the game.

[*] The big castle is now finally available to explore! within it, there is even another small human village!

[*] You can now find the Golden Horn with which you can open the Southern Steyndike gate.

[*] There are now haybale models for human farm fields which will be added in the first lowlands update.

[*] The player now finally has a jump-start animation.

[*] Gnome camps now have NPCs who sell things.

[*] There are now spike obstacles, that go up and down rapidly, mainly will be used in caves.

[*] There are now troll elevators, made by kind trolls who live deep down in the caves, their traps are meant to keep out the big bad trolls, but can also be dangerous for players!

[*] You can now find green and blue human doors which can be opened when you have drunk the right potion, the magical green door potion and the magical blue door potion to be precise, you will also need one of these potions in order to find the key to the southern Steyndike maze, and thus the lowlands.

[*] More NPCs with dialogue options have been added, making the story clear and helping the player explore and discover.

[*] Last but not least! you can now open the gates to the lowlands when you have found the right key and completed the maze!
[/list]





[b]Fixed Bugs and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Box (thing lines) floating behind the player, seen in the intro and when sitting, and also when speed boosting has been removed.

[*] The game has seen many optimizations in textures.

[*] Music now fades when the wolf sees the player.

[*] The player not sitting in the chair correctly is now fixed.

[*] The map should no longer be blurry upon opening it.

[*] Some smaller rocks now also disappear when the camera gets too close to them, like the leaves.

[*] Caves and other things of interest are now easier to find, just follow the sounds :D

[*] Some parts of the mountain area have been made more detailed.

[*] Some parts of the forest have been made more detailed.

[*] A lot of models have had further optimization.

[*] Dialogue has been improved, it now has a sound, Capital letters, and the pacing of the words is better for reading.

[*] You now get rewarded with spirit points after you've completed a dialogue with an NPC.

[*] A part of the map has fewer or no floating rocks and grass, more of the map will have these errors removed in the future.

[*] Some experimental 3d textures have been added to some trees to see if this looks better.

[*] The camera now zooms back to the first-person mode when pressing E or Q, third-person mode was only added so the player can see themselves in high-density foilage areas or simply to look at the player character, the game is meant to be a first-person experience. There were multiple cases where people said E didn't work, but they were in third-person mode, now this should be more clear to players.

[*] Recourses such as logs rocks and metal now occasionally light up with a small pulse to indicate that that rock or tree can be harvested.

[*] Level up particle effect has been changed.

[*] One of the waterfalls had a strange blocking volume attached, and no underwater effects, now it does.

[*] Humans have slightly been enhanced, and the weird-looking necks have been fixed.

[*] all gnomes and human NPCs now blink their eyes making them less creepy.

[*] Humans can now walk up the stairs if they feel like doing so.

[*] Night trolls now die after they get hit by sunlight for a while.

[*] Pressing inventory while holding local key bug has been fixed, no white square will appear in inventory now.

[*] Grabbing food while already holding an item has been fixed, no longer will a white square appear or a duplicated item in the inventory through this bug.

[*] You can no longer sit down holding an item, as to prevent that item from getting stuck once standing up or spawning in the wrong place.
 
[*] You can no longer drop or pick from inventory items and objects, while being held, driving the boat, sitting in a chair, etc. Removing the bug where the player suddenly gets different animation while in process of being held or sitting.

[*] Clicking the left mouse button on the Speed plant kept opening and closing the plant without telling the player what to do, now it simply closes and gives instructions.

[/list]

The game is currently in Alpha 0.5, at 1.0 the game will go into beta, luckily the hardest part of the development is now behind us which means going from 0.5 to 1.0 won't take another whole year but probably a few months. :D

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.4.1 Caves, Wolfs, Speed Travel and much more!
notes.content:
[b]A quick overview of fixed bugs, improvements, and new things added in this update.
[/b]


[b]New In Little Hats:[/b]

[list]
[*] You can now travel around the world faster than ever before! Every now and again a speed-boosting plant will appear as you are sprinting, when you sprint over these plants and click the left mouse button you will get a speed boost, and if you can spot the next plant in the distance you can use this to travel really fast and quickly across the map.

notes.title: The Little Hats Plan (next few months)
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! For those who don't know, my name is Tim, I'm the guy from the cover picture of this update. I am also the (Only) Developer of Little Hats, I'm as of now 20 years of age, and I live in the Netherlands, for those who were wondering.[/b]

[b]First of all, thank you to all the Little Hats players for making this game possible! Here follows a quick overview of the plan for the next few months. [/b]

[h1][b]The Plan:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] After having worked on Little Hats full-time for most of the last 3 years I plan to take a six-week break, starting tomorrow until July the 4th. During this time there won't be any updates or patches. During the break, I will think of and hopefully complete a great story for Little Hats, the time off will also allow me to fully regenerate all the passion with which I started this game, and also come up with good ideas to make the game more fun.

[*] Then in July, I plan to (hopefully finally) manage to complete and implement the map system, as well as more NPCs, more craftable items, and more items to craft with like flowers and other types of mushrooms, and recourses. I will also try to make a hunter system, meaning during the day there will be humans looking for gnomes and there will then also be traps for gnomes in the forest

[*] From August onward I will begin designing the low lands area of the map, specifically the snowy area. I will rejudge what else will be smart to add to make the game more fun in early August, this will be based on what at that time would be best to add.
[/list]

[b]Again, I sincerely appreciate all the support. Thank you Little Hats players! 

I will do everything to make the potential of this game a reality!

Sincerely,

Tim Venekamp
[/b]

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.5 Combat and Clothing!
notes.content:
[b]A quick overview of the bug fixes, and improvements, in this update.
[/b]


[b]New In Little Hats:[/b]

[list]
[*] You can now find backpacks in a few locations, once you equip one of them you get 4 extra inventory slots!

[*] You can also find a few different types of clothes which you can put on, more will be added later, as well as certain benefits such as speed, more health, etc when wearing different clothes.

[*] You can now also pick up forks, knives, and spoons to fight against evil humans!

[*] You can now use the pickaxe and Axe as a weapon.

[*] You can now buy a poleaxe or sword to fight trolls and other evil NPCs.

[*] you can now kill and fight all evil NPCs.

[*] You can now hit all not evil NPCs and potentially kill them... Which, because you play a gnome will cause you to lose spirit points, and if you do it too many times you will become an evil gnome, then you won't be allowed to do certain things and your character will look evil!

[*] You can now find loose stones, logs, and metal ore lying around the ground, as well as more mushrooms spread across the map.

[*] There now is a Mobile Crafting Menu when you press f3, this will allow you to craft some basic items, such as a primitive Axe, pickaxe, and more!
 
[*] A primitive Axe has been added, a little less effective than the original Axe but it does the job.

[*] A primitive Pickaxe has also been added.

[*] There is now a Simple Work Bench that can be crafted from the mobile crafting menu, this simple workbench allows you to make a basic building and craft a normal workbench.

[*] Gnome towns now have their own ambient day and night music, and some other areas such as human towns, the swamp, and more, have new music as well, more will be added later.

[*] You will now get more recourses from saplings, rock, and metal, and they will count as more than 1 in the crafting menu, making it easier to craft more.
[/list]



[b]Fixed Bugs and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] The player's head looking weird when riding on the fox has been fixed.

[*] Player's head looking down while crouching has been fixed.

[*] Quil found in human and gnome homes should no longer be affected by outside wind.

[*] When the rain starts and the player is inside the rain no longer is visible inside.

[*] Players and NPCs should no longer get stuck in the trees.

[*] the big troll has had more optimization as well as the small one.

[*] Players should no longer spawn inside the big troll when picked up.

[*] The door of the shop wagon won't push you away anymore or cause you to get stuck.

[*] You can now enter the shop wagon again.

[*] Spirit points have been optimized, you will now no longer get fast leveling from mining. It should be more balanced now, but then again, depending on feedback it might change a few more times in the near future before a nice balance is found.

[*] When mining ore the ore will no longer fly all over the place.

[*] You can now mine stone with an Axe, or primitive Axe, you will however get much less stone that way.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.0 Weather System, and Lots of Enhancements!
notes.content:
[b]A quick overview of the bug fixes, and improvements, in this update.
[/b]


[b]New In Little Hats:[/b]

[list]
[*] The game now has a weather system, there are now a variety of different types of weather that dynamically keep changing. There will now be rain, hard winds, storms, rainstorms, and a bunch of different types of fog. 

[*] Some humans will now take out their umbrellas when it starts to rain.

[*] Guard AI now has new animations, including a ready-to-attack animation for when trolls and such are near.

[*] Dangerous NPCs can now be seen on the compass, to help prevent jump scares.

[*] The nearest rideable animal can now be seen on the compass, for the player to go around the map faster.

[*] The nearest gnome can now also be seen on the compass, to help the player find gnomes to talk to.

[*] And also the nearest normal animal can be seen on the compass, to help players discover new animals.

[*] The swamp area has some more puddles to make it feel a bit more interesting.

[*] The night troll now makes a sound when you've come near him, this should give you a heads up!

[*] The player stays on fire a little while longer after having stepped into a fire. You can put the fire out by running into the rain or into the water.

[*] Player mine and tree chop animations have been improved.

[*] There are now leaves falling from trees, and they get affected by the wind, adding more to the atmosphere of the game.

[*] The player character now has an animation when picked up to talk to a friendly human.

[*] The player character now has face animations.

[*] The player character now has a better sit animation.
[/list]




[b]Fixed Bugs and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] When you don't talk to Gerwini in the intro part, you didn't get a quest, now you will get the quest also without talking to Gerwini so the rest of the game works well.

[*] Save not loading, or rather loading screen not going away should be fixed.

[*] Guard Ai should no longer turn around and move randomly and has also been optimized.

[*] The oxygen bar not disappearing has been fixed, it will now disappear after being fully filled again when getting out of the water.

[*] The clothing glitch on some of the gnomes was fixed.

[*] Sings should no longer be falling to the ground or be floating halfway down from where they are supposed to be hanging, will require some more testing to make sure it doesn't happen again.

[*] Being picked up while holding a frog will now drop the frog, where before the frog would glitch to the player's right hand.

[*] The Deer at begin of the map have been replaced by a fox, as they are more easily ridable in the complex starting area and rarer to find elsewhere in the world.

[*] Gnome entrances into human houses should now all be visible and the player should no longer be able to look into the house before it's loaded.

[*] Right-click on berry bush spawning multiple berries has been fixed to where it now only spawns one.

[*] The infamous duck bug, where the player spawns upside down after being thrown off the duck, should be fixed, it will however require more players to test to make sure it's not still present.

[*] NPCs that disappeared after reloading should now be saved before respawn.

[*] Day and night last longer now, the day-night cycle is now less quick.

[*] When the third-person camera goes into the river the player no longer moves.

[*] Leaves now shine a little bit of light through them and are a bit transparent like real leaves.
[/list]


[b]There are about 25 more bugs that I am currently aware of and a few more areas that could use some optimization. I'm back to adding more things to the game and will at the same time fix these last few bugs, as well as new ones. 

Tim[/b]

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.2.5 New Gnome City, Birds and More!
notes.content:
[b]A quick overview of the bug fixes, improvements, and new additions in this update.
[/b]


[b]New in Little Hats:[/b]

[list]
[*] The hidden gnome city of Bolderberg has been added!

[*] A new furniture store in Bolderberg with 6 new furniture items that the player can buy.

[*] An art store where the player can buy some paintings and tiles.

[*] A music store where the player can buy a trumpet and will be able to buy more instruments in the future.

[*] A blacksmith where the player will be able to buy weapons after the combat update.

[*] All nature assets have had changes in appearance to make everything fit and work together better.

[*] The game has had some style changes making everything look a bit darker but more aligned with the vision for the game, and making most colors work together better.

[*] Human umbrella prop has been made, humans will take out their umbrella when it starts to rain, after the weather update.

[*] The birds are back! the veteran Little Hats players who bought the game back in September 2021 will likely know that the game had birds at that point, but due to lag they were temporarily removed. I've finally been able to optimize the bird system and they are back flying around the world of Little Hats!

[*] The game has seen further optimization in multiple areas.

[*] The player character has been improved, both his clothing and the character himself, now look a lot better.
[/list]





[b]Fixed Bugs and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Random teleport back to the spawn area cave has been removed.

[b] Next week's update will likely add the much-awaited map to the game, as well as a backpack and the ability to put on other clothes! I will try my best to do more bug fixing and optimizing for next week's update. As for 0.2.5, I didn't have quite enough time for it.

Tim[/b]

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.2.2 Big Update! Compass, Squirrels, Hare's and more!
notes.content:
[b]A quick overview of the bug fixes, improvements, and new additions in this update.
[/b]

[b]Update 0.2.1 has been merged with update 0.2.2 because of technical reasons.[/b]

[b]New in Little Hats:[/b]

[list]
[*] Compass system, the HUD now has a compass system that allows you to see where north, south, west, and east are as well as points of interest such as towns, near shops, houses, and shop wagons. When you place a crafting table of sorts it will be shown on the compass as well, as a yellow house, indicating where your house is, when you place another one somewhere it will show the nearest to your current location as the yellow house in the compass.

[*] The game now has Hares (Similar to a rabbit) walking and running around the map.

[*] Squirrels have been added! they will also be roaming around the map.

[*] The game now has a passive mode for young and easily scared children or people who wish to play without the trolls and dangers.

[*] A guide has been added that can be accessed from the ESC menu, this allows the player to quickly look up how some things work, please let me know if there's anything else you would like me to explain in the guide.

[*] A heartbeat sound has been added and will play when you are badly hurt.

[*] More signs have been added on the human roads as well as some buildings.

[*] Some new maps have been added as decore in some human houses.

[*] More gnome NPC animations, they now have a fall animation for when they're falling. As well as improved run animations. They also have a scared animation now.

[*] Some gnome will now crouch down and cover their head in fear when a troll or human comes near.

[*] There are now tutorial messages for building and mining. 

[*] The first few times you pick up an item a message will appear to tell you that you can put it in your inventory by pressing 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.

[*] The game now has tips on the loading screens, to help players learn about the game and how to play it.

[*] There is now a new area discovered message for the Forest Crater.

[*] You now get Spirit Points and a New Animal Discovered message when you discover a new animal and press E on it. The message will also tell you what animal it is, for the younger players a fun way to learn new animals.

[*] New human food can be found, the papflap, or Belgium papflap, this sweet food will instantly remove all hunger and most thirst as well as increase health, making it the most valuable food in Little Hats.

[*] There are now 4 humans with who you can have a dialogue.

[/list]


[b]Fixed Bugs and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] UI has completely been improved, almost everything has seen changes from the main menu to the in-game shops, all texts should now also be easier to read.

[*] HUD update, small HUD improvements.

[*] The wheelBarrow has been fixed, the player wasn't able to put resources into it, fixed now.

[*] Ability to remove player build object without demolishing tool by holding E for a while works once more.

[*] The castle interior in Ravenwoud didn't load on time.

[*] Black interior transition material interfered with some of the houses in Ravenwoud, this has been fixed

[*] The bug when the camera moves into the player and the mouth and eyes are seen, should be fixed now, it's one of the strangest bugs that I have encountered, and will require more testing to make sure it doesn't show up again.

[*] White cubes are no longer visible at the castle gatehouse in Ravenwoud.

[*] Human items now properly disappear at a certain distance, further optimizing the game.

[*] Player buildings now disappear at a distance further improving the game's performance.

[*] Shop keeper animations kept stopping, this has been fixed. But the old floating heads bug has reappeared and will be fixed ASAP. 

[*] Waterfalls had missing textures, this should be fixed but will require more testing to make sure it doesn't happen again.

[*] One of the smaller human towns somehow got deleted through an error, an older version of it has been implemented but is not as well optimized. This also caused the loading screen to not go away, which it should now no longer do.

[*] Some changes have been made to the main menu.
[/list]



[b]The remaining bugs and improvements are currently being worked on and should soon be fixed in update 0.2.3

Tim[/b]

notes.title: Progress Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Here's a quick overview of some of the progress:

[list]
[*] The human-AI has been implemented into the game.
[*] The forest part of the world (Called Steyn Wood) is now completely done and counts two human cities, three human villages, and a couple of other human settlements such as two castles, and a few farms, after the early access release, I will begin working on the lowlands part of the map, this part of the map will be a few times larger than the current forest part, and the forest is already of considerable size.
[*] Animals have been added to the world, and many more will follow after early access.
[*] Tons of optimizing has happened to make the game run a lot better.
[*] The crafting and resource gathering has also seen updates, adding things like a wheelbarrow that allows the player to gather more resources at once.
[*] I have also worked out the basis of the story and worked out a lot of lore for the world, parts of it have already been implemented, and more will follow after the early access release.
[*] A dialogue system has been implemented allowing the player to talk to gnomes and other creatures.
[*] A new type of troll has been added to the game, even scarier than the other one.
[/list]

A lot of other things have been added to the game as well, by the end of this month I will try to update the Steam store page, and maybe also make a new updated trailer, but this will depend on how well progress goes over the next few weeks, as my primary focus as of now is to make Little Hats work as best as it can for the Early Access release.
